name: Entity CRUD Alter Status Message
description: Customizes the status message shown after create/update/delete of node, taxonomy term and media entities, using per entity-type/bundle/action config entities with token support.
project_description:
The Entity CRUD Alter Status Message module provides a way to alter the status message that is displayed after a CRUD operation on an entity. Initially the module only provides 3 entities types to alter (node, taxonomy and media).

 Features 
 To customise the message for specific entity actions, select the entity type and bundle, then specify the action you want to trigger the message. Fill in the desired message. When the selected entity is created, updated, or deleted, your custom message will replace the default one.

 Post-Installation 
 After installation, navigate to the message listing page under the 'System' menu to create your status message alerts.
